rows.summary: Between 2020 and 2024, Wyndham lowered the minimum Initial Franchise Fee floor, replaced separate Opening Training fees with a new $4,000 per year Continuing Education fee, removed the disclosed Revenue Management onboarding service, and made several PMS procurement, set-up fee, upgrade, and training-expense changes.
rows.reviewReason: deterministic evidence check failed (old=normalized_whitespace, new=none); exact inclusion is not explicit; schema repair: same_concept_match conflicted with change_type; schema repaired in v4.3; separate fee disappeared while a related bundle appeared; verify before research use normalized numeric value is not present in side-specific evidence; Old fee string '$2,0002,250' is an OCR concatenation that may represent $2,000 to $2,250 or a malformed rendering of $2,250; source PDF check required. schema repair: same_concept_match conflicted with change_type; schema repaired in v4.3; verify before research use

oldEvidence.quote: The Initial Franchise Fee for a new construction or conversion System HotelChain Facility is equal to the greater of $54,500 or $500 per room.

Revenue Management Services – FourSix months of Start-Up Platinum Revenue Management Services for your System HotelChain Facility beginning thirty days from your Opening Date. Services include scheduled communication and accessibility, bi-weekly meetings, STR review and evaluation, rate and inventory maintenance, strategic positioning, future demand strategy and targeted promotions and packages. The value of these Revenue Management Services is $4,500.
The fee for this mandatory training program is $2,0002,250, which you will be billed within 90 days following the Opening Date of the hotel.
This training is conducted on site at your Facility anywhere from two weeks prior to, or up to 30 days after, the Facility’s Opening Date.

The duration and fee for this training is dependent on the size of your Facility as follows: $750 for 0-50 rooms (1 day), $2,250 for 51-200 rooms (up to 3 days) and $3,750 for 200+ rooms (up to 5 days), plus travel, lodging and meal expenses of the facilitator.

Franchisees who are renewing their franchises are not required to participate in our Hospitality Management Program, provided your general manager has completed the training within the last eight years.

You must purchase the server hardware from us and the OPERA® operating system software license from Oracle Hospitality (“Oracle”) which will function as the HotelFacility’s property management system (“PMS”)
You will subscribe and obtain the licenses required to operate the OPERA PMS through the subscription based OPERA SaaS Model offered by Oracle under the Oracle Master Agreement.
You must sign the OPERA Supplemental Services Agreement with us, which may include additional services and fees including monthly support and interface fees paid after opening.
You must pay us a one-time set-up and implementation fee of $23,075 plus additional amounts for interfaces that may be required.
You must provide complimentary lodging for our trainers if the training is provided at the HotelFacility.

newEvidence.quote: The Initial Franchise Fee for a new construction or conversion Chain Facility is equal to the greater of $50,000 or $500 per room.
$2,250, which will be billed within 90 days following the Opening Date of the Facility.
a hybrid, in-person and virtual format or ii) a virtual-only format.
This training is conducted on site at your Facility anywhere from two weeks prior to, or up to 90 days after, the Facility’s Opening Date.
are included in your Continuing Education Fee.
Continuing Education – We will provide a comprehensive curriculum of hotel operations
$4,000 per year.
However, renewal franchisees may be exempt from our Hospitality Management Program, provided their general manager has completed the training within the last eight years.
$225 for each additional room type.
The hardware for the PMS may be purchased from any source so long as it meets our technology standards and minimum technical requirements.
you must sign the Master Information Technology Agreement (“MITA”) with us along with the applicable PMS Schedule.

When you choose the OPERA PMS, you must pay a one-time non-refundable Set-Up and Implementation Fee ranging from $18,825 to $28,425 plus additional amounts for interfaces that may be required, depending on which level of OPERA system you select.
This fee includes on-site deployment, installation, and training and must be paid at least 30 days before the Opening Date of the Facility.

You will be required to subscribe to any future OPERA upgrade when it becomes available, which may include additional or different services and fees, and you may be required to execute a new OPERA Schedule to the MITA, or amend your current OPERA Schedule.
You are responsible for travel and lodging expenses for our trainer(s) if the training is provided at the Facility.

rows.inferenceLimit: Only the fixed floor amount changed; the per-room amount is unchanged, and the fee impact depends on room count. Do not infer that the service is not actually delivered under the Franchise Agreement; the code captures removal of the disclosed inclusion and stated $4,500 value. Old fee text is OCR-concatenated; do not treat '$2,0002,250' as a confirmed range or flat amount without checking the source PDF. Do not infer which format was actually used in any year or that travel costs changed. The change is to the disclosed maximum scheduling window; do not infer when training actually occurred or whether schedule flexibility was exercised. Do not compare the old tiered fees to the new $4,000 Continuing Education Fee as an equivalent price; coverage and base differ. Do not infer that total training costs increased by $4,000 because old Opening Training fees were separately charged and are now bundled; the $4,000 is not a net-add relative to old fees. Do not infer which renewals actually received exemptions or paid HMP fees. Do not infer that any franchisee was required to buy or actually bought additional photos. Do not infer actual price differences or that all hardware sources were accepted. Do not infer that the underlying license type (subscription vs perpetual) changed; the new text still contemplates ongoing fees and upgrades. Do not treat the old fixed fee as directly below or above the new fee; a given franchisee's fee depends on the OPERA level selected and interface needs. Do not infer that the fee was actually paid earlier or later in practice. Do not infer that any upgrade became available or was adopted between 2020 and 2024. Do not infer actual travel costs or that training was provided at the facility.
